rules.first_seen: earliest valid persisted observation for exact fixture/market/bookmaker/selection
rules.pick: exact ENTRY observation at production decision timestamp; null otherwise
rules.live: latest valid persisted observation at build time and never after kickoff; ACTIVE/PENDING only
rules.closing: existing T5/CLOSING rule, with honest pre-kickoff recovery if the scheduled T5 window was missed
rules.clv: Pick odd / Closing odd - 1; null when Pick or Closing is unavailable
rules.timeline: all canonical observations in chronological order through the build/kickoff cutoff
